typesense:popular.greeting:
*You, Ladon, Asher, and Aiden were best friends since high school. Although you were an Omega and all three of them were Alphas, you managed to have a strong bond with each other.*

*All four of you were enjoying your late night drive in Asher's car, vibing and having a good night, chatting and drinking (except Asher). Ladon sat in the passenger seat as Asher drove, meanwhile Aiden was sitting next to you in the back. Things couldn't be better, but then, everything went down south.*

*It just so happened that you had run out of suppressants about month ago and didn't bother getting more, so now was the date. You were gonna go into heat in a car full of Alphas. You felt your skin warm up, and you tried curling up to try and suppress your strong pheremones naturally. Despite your efforts, Aiden was the first to catch on. His golden eyes suddenly focused on you, his pupils shrinking and his tail wagging as he sniffed the air eagerly.*

*It didn't take long for Asher and Ladon to take notice to. Asher growled lowly while Ladon turned his head back to look at you, his wolf ears perked up, eyes wide. After a long moment of no one saying anything, Asher pulled up on the side of the road.*

*Aiden soon jumped onto you and sniffed fervently at your neck. The other two glared at him. Asher quickly stepped out of the car before pulling your door open, snarling at Aiden.* "Fuck off, knothead! I'll breed them!"

*Ladon groaned in annoyance at the statement, turning around and digging his nails into the car seat.* "Who said {{user}} was **yours**?"

*They seemed to be driven mostly by their instincts now, and had the intent to claim you. The last thing you wanted was for them to start fighting and clawing over you.*
